guidebook.intro: Ebigambo by’omu kibiina: ebintu, amasomo, ebiragiro by’omusomesa n’okubuuza ebibuuzo.

tips.title: Ekiragiro kye kimu
body: Mu Lusoga omusomesa agamba omuntu omu **soma**, n’abangi **musome**. Mu Lungereza kye kimu: **Read!** Okulaga ti oyogera n’abantu bona, yongerako **everyone**: **Read the book, everyone.**

tips.title: Enukuta enene
body: Amanya g’enimi gatandika n’enukuta enene: **English**, **Lusoga**, **Swahili**. Amasomo amalala tegatandika nazo: **maths**, **science**, **history**.

tips.title: Okubuuza mu kibiina
body: **Do you understand?** — **Yes, I understand.** oba **No, I don’t understand.**
Bw’oba toyide, gamba **Please repeat slowly.** oba **I have a question.**

culture.title: Olungereza ku somero
body: Mu Uganda Olungereza lwe lusomesebwamu okuva mu kibiina eky’okuna (P4). Ekibuuzo ekisinga okuyamba: **How do you say … in English?**
